mostWorthwhile.text: Pressing the screened regolith was most worthwhile: the explanation made clear why the weak blanks need support and firing.

leastWorthwhile.text: The sieve and screening sequence was clear but somewhat repetitive, with only one offered combination at each step.

surprise.text: The chapter ended with unfired blanks, even though the solar furnace was assembled; forming the feedstock did not include firing it.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The offered combinations had clear purposes, although the later choices were essentially prescribed.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, to see how the furnace and blanks are used; the practical explanations made the making process interesting.
